title: We built roguelike deckbuilder by using AI for assets. We need feedbacks
author: SnooShortcuts3909
selftext:
We write the code ourself, since we are developer backed. But we had some help of the ai by creating some of the assets. If you love roguelike deckbuilders where you assemble a broken score engine, this should feel right at home — except the poker hands are recipes and the crowd is monsters.

It's **still in active development** — full release planned for **Q4 2026** — so the demo's rough on purpose. That's why we're here: **we want your honest feedback and ideas.** What clicks? What'd make you keep playing?

🎮 **Play the demo:** [Feastfall Demo](https://yuzukigamestudio.itch.io/feastfall)  
🚀 **Wishlist on Steam:** [Steam Link](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4904080/Feastfall)

comments.author: Zerrul
comments.body:
My honest opinion?

Looks like AI. All of it. The card images have that chatgpt style to them, the UI is dark and brown and over detailed, it's got that clear GPT AI all up in your face with very little in the way of making it unique beyond the prompt you used

Some people won't care, especially if the game is fun. But something so clearly GPT will have a hard time standing out amongst the endless masses of familiar GPT games

replies.author: Angry_Eyelash
replies.body: Art is the only thing I'd never ask Ai to create, personnally. I'm using free assets I got from itch.io and plan on buying some unique ones later when I have some pocket money. It's really not that expensive and it makes your game look truly unique.

replies.author: SnooShortcuts3909
replies.body: I'm already capable of doing the coding part easily. What is the best place to find people to buy assets ?

replies.author: Angry_Eyelash
replies.body: I mentioned itch.io because it has a beginner friendly interface and a huge catalog of assets (tilesets, main characters, enemies, vfx,...) ordered by genre and other filters

replies.author: DoctaRoboto
replies.body: I have been posting about this for weeks. You all aspiring AI game devs need a way to craft your own aesthetic, or soon the market will be flooded with the same generic art style, and gamers will get sick and just ignore anything that looks like this.

comments.author: Vinbatroth
comments.body: If you have a local GPU, try using Cmyui I for your game images. Assets will look less ChatGPT generic.

replies.author: Vinbatroth
replies.body: Use Ideogram 4 or Krea 2 for more control in the image, also there are pixel creators in CMFYUI. Civitai is a webpage that hosts different art styles that are called loras. For this, just type "pixel art".
